cross_row_audit.auxiliary_files_review: Only public/train.csv, public/eval.csv, and private/holdout.csv are written; no fixture labels, answer scaffolds, or auxiliary evaluation files.
cross_row_audit.rationale: Rows are one per PE action number; features are confined to the opening investigation record lines and no label-derived group rates or cross-row outcomes are shipped. The high-cardinality declarations are metadata about shipped columns, not per-row outcome aggregates.

component.availability: Present as COMPNAME on the opening record; empty values are retained as missing, not zero. When an action number spans multiple lines, the lexicographically first valid line supplies COMPNAME.

investigation_id.availability: NHTSA action number from field 1; exactly one shipped row per action number after collapsing the make/model lines for a PE; PE prefix is the population filter.

make.availability: Present on the opening investigation record; when an action number spans multiple make/model lines, the lexicographically first valid line supplies MAKE.

manufacturer.availability: Present as MFR_NAME on the opening record; empty values are retained as missing, not zero. When an action number spans multiple lines, the lexicographically first valid line supplies MFR_NAME.

model.availability: Present on the opening investigation record; when an action number spans multiple make/model lines, the lexicographically first valid line supplies MODEL; the field may contain a list.

model_count.availability: Derived from MODEL across all valid lines of the PE; distinct non-empty names are split on comma or semicolon; delimiter interpretation is assumed.
model_count.source: https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/ffdd/inv/INV.txt (field 3 MODEL across the PE lines, derived)

model_year.availability: Present as YEAR on the opening record; 9999 is unknown and excluded; values 1900 through 2019 retained. When an action number spans multiple lines, the lexicographically first valid line supplies YEAR.

open_date.availability: ODATE field 7; event date used for chronological splits and conservative day clusters.

vehicle_age.availability: Derived only from ODATE and the representative line YEAR at opening; negative ages are not clipped.

limitations: Current-vintage retrospective snapshot: the 2026 ODI file may reflect later corrections and does not prove the fields were operationally available in real time during 1995-2019.

Multiple make/model lines sharing one NHTSA action number are collapsed to one row per PE; the deterministic representative line discards within-PE variation in make, model, model year, component, and manufacturer.
CAMPNO attribution is imperfect: one recall may be linked to multiple PEs or models, and a PE may be followed by an EA; using PE only reduces but does not eliminate shared-event dependence.
Recall timing uses RCDATE from the recall file; if CAMPNO is present but unmatched or RCDATE is missing, the row is labeled 0 under the frozen rule, which can understate escalation.
Territorial limit: Public Domain U.S. Government status rests on 17 U.S.C. 105 and does not establish worldwide public domain; manufacturer names and trademarks remain third-party.
No production or sales exposure; recall propensity is not normalized by fleet size.
YEAR 9999 is used to exclude equipment, tire, and child-restraint records, but some vehicle PEs with unknown model years are dropped.
MODEL delimiter interpretation is assumed; if the source uses a different list separator, model_count may undercount or overcount.
No full-row availability ledger exists, so training_label_timing is unverified and feature availability is documented-field evidence plus explicit assumptions.

selection.evidence: ODATE is the PE open date; MAKE, MODEL, YEAR, COMPNAME, and MFR_NAME are opening-record fields. Multiple make/model lines for one action number are collapsed to a single PE row; the snapshot is retrospective and does not prove real-time availability.
selection.rule: Keep action numbers beginning with PE; parse ODATE as YYYYMMDD; keep 1995-01-01 through 2019-12-31; require non-empty MAKE and MODEL on at least one line; require YEAR 1900 through 2019; drop YEAR 9999 and unparseable ODATE; collapse remaining lines to one row per action number. Labels are not used for row selection.

vintage.evidence: 2026 NHTSA ODI flat files; later corrections may be reflected.

measurements.frame: INV.txt field 4 YEAR of the deterministic representative line; 9999 treated as unknown and excluded by population
ODATE calendar year minus the representative line MODEL YEAR
distinct non-empty model names across all make/model lines of the PE, split on comma or semicolon
linked RCDATE minus ODATE; campaign join on normalized CAMPNO values unioned across the PE lines

task.population: PE investigations opened 1995-01-01 through 2019-12-31 with a parseable ODATE, non-empty MAKE and MODEL on at least one make/model line, and YEAR from 1900 through 2019; multiple lines sharing an action number are collapsed to one row per action number using the lexicographically first valid line and a model count across lines; excludes YEAR 9999 equipment, tire, and child-restraint records and rows without a parseable ODATE.
task.prediction_time: The PE open date (ODATE), before investigation findings, closure, or a recall campaign number are known.
task.question: Will a newly opened NHTSA preliminary evaluation (PE) into a vehicle defect result in a linked safety recall campaign within 24 months?
task.simple_references: Majority class; manufacturer base rate; component base rate; model-year age-only; open-year base rate.
task.split_policy: Chronological by ODATE: train 1995-01-01 through 2007-12-31; eval 2008-01-01 through 2014-12-31; holdout 2015-01-01 through 2019-12-31. One row per PE action number; no embargo; each row is a distinct PE and no feature uses another row's outcome. All 24-month label windows close by 2021-12-31, before the 2026 snapshot.
task.target: 1 if any CAMPNO value on the PE lines is non-empty and at least one linked recall campaign has an RCDATE after ODATE and on or before ODATE plus 730 days; 0 otherwise. CAMPNO, CDATE, status, and recall records are label-only.
task.title: Will a newly opened NHTSA preliminary evaluation produce a safety recall within 24 months?
task.usefulness: At opening, the recall outcome is unknown and CAMPNO is absent; the model must combine component, manufacturer, model-year, and probe breadth to forecast regulatory escalation. This supports triage and is not a copied field.

assumptions: No reporting-period schedule or publication lag is known for the ODI flat files; timing is event-time ODATE and historical real-time availability is unverified.

prediction_instant.citation: INV.txt field 7 ODATE is the date the investigation opened

row_selection.rule: Keep action numbers beginning with PE; parse ODATE as YYYYMMDD; keep 1995-01-01 through 2019-12-31; require non-empty MAKE and MODEL on at least one line; require YEAR 1900 through 2019; drop YEAR 9999 and unparseable ODATE; collapse remaining make/model lines to one row per action number. No outcome conditioning.
